name: Yang Order-Sphere Obstruction
definition: For an ample family $H$ of order $m\ge2$, let $\mathscr O(H)$ be the order complex of the proper nonempty subsets of $H$. Each latent Yang chart defines a failure poset and the order complex $\mathscr R_B$ of its proper nontrivial ideals. With $\mathscr U(H)=\bigcup_B\mathscr R_B$, define $\omega_{\mathrm{ord}}(H)=\dim_{\mathbb F_2}\widetilde H_{m-2}(\mathscr U(H);\mathbb F_2)$.
normalization: Set $\omega_{\mathrm{ord}}(H)=0$ for the one-concept ample family. For $m\ge2$, homology is taken in the top dimension $m-2$ of the order sphere over $\mathbb F_2$.
comments: This is the colored latent-chart version of the metric Yang obstruction. Both equal one exactly on nonpeelable ample families, although their canonical covers encode different local data.
